tasks.label: CMake: Configure (clang-x64)
tasks.detail: One-time. Ninja regenerates automatically after CMakeLists changes.
args: $vs = & 'C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe' -latest -property installationPath; Import-Module (Join-Path $vs 'Common7\Tools\Microsoft.VisualStudio.DevShell.dll'); Enter-VsDevShell -VsInstallPath $vs -SkipAutomaticLocation -DevCmdArguments '-arch=x64 -host_arch=x64' | Out-Null; cmake --preset clang-x64

tasks.label: Build batmanak-rend2
args: $vs = & 'C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe' -latest -property installationPath; Import-Module (Join-Path $vs 'Common7\Tools\Microsoft.VisualStudio.DevShell.dll'); Enter-VsDevShell -VsInstallPath $vs -SkipAutomaticLocation -DevCmdArguments '-arch=x64 -host_arch=x64' | Out-Null; cmake --build --preset clang-x64-debug --target batmanak-rend2

tasks.label: Build devkit
args: $vs = & 'C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe' -latest -property installationPath; Import-Module (Join-Path $vs 'Common7\Tools\Microsoft.VisualStudio.DevShell.dll'); Enter-VsDevShell -VsInstallPath $vs -SkipAutomaticLocation -DevCmdArguments '-arch=x64 -host_arch=x64' | Out-Null; cmake --build --preset clang-x64-debug --target devkit mcp_bridge

tasks.label: Link addons into game folder
tasks.detail: Symlinks built addons into Binaries\Win64. Needs Developer Mode or an elevated shell.
args: $game = 'D:\SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Batman Arkham Knight\Binaries\Win64'; foreach ($n in 'renodx-batmanak-rend2.addon64', 'renodx-devkit.addon64') { $src = Join-Path '${workspaceFolder}\build\Debug' $n; $dst = Join-Path $game $n; if (-not (Test-Path $src)) { Write-Host ('skip {0} (not built)' -f $n); continue }; $existing = Get-Item $dst -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($existing -and -not $existing.LinkType) { Write-Host ('CONFLICT: {0} is a real file, leaving it alone' -f $dst); continue }; if ($existing) { Remove-Item $dst }; New-Item -ItemType SymbolicLink -Path $dst -Target $src | Out-Null; Write-Host ('linked {0}' -f $n) }
